9:r-drj|### Fixed
10:47DEQ|
11:2P18h|- A `params` string sent as a JSON string literal, with its quotes and `\n` escapes, reaches the program decoded, also when the program declares a string input (#368). 14:47DEQ|
15:LhaSL|### Added
16:47DEQ|
17:NjwXp|- `workspace.viewImage` works on pi-durable hosts such as pi-action, with the limits it has on Pi, and the image reaches the model (#365). 19:r-drj|### Fixed
20:47DEQ|

Providers that sample the tool input with Pit's grammar have no `label` argument, so their calls showed "Run workspace task" in the transcript; they now carry the model's label.

v: README.md:53 Run `/reload` after updating. Prefer a fixed release? Use `pi install git:github.com/cv/pit@v0.36.3` instead; package updates won't move a pinned install.
pa: docs/configuration.md:50 On [pi-durable hosts](durable.md#tools-the-model-sees) such as pi-action, `allowedTools` applies the same way to the tools Pit hides there, pi-durable's coding tools by default. Pit reads it when the host creates the extension; the project's file needs the host's `trustProject` and `cwd` options.

docs/durable.md:3 Pit is a Pi extension, but its `typescript` tool also runs on hosts built on [`@earendil-works/pi-durable`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-durable), such as [pi-action](https://github.com/cv/pi-action), which keeps one durable conversation per GitHub issue or pull request. The `pit/durable` entry point exports a pi-durable extension: the tool, its usage guidelines, and the user and project function catalogs as prompt sections.

docs/durable.md:3 Pit is a Pi extension, but its `typescript` tool also runs on hosts built on [`@earendil-works/pi-durable`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-durable), such as [pi-action](https://github.com/cv/pi-action), which keeps one durable conversation per GitHub issue or pull request. The `pit/durable` entry point exports a pi-durable extension: the tool, its usage guidelines, and the user and project function catalogs as prompt sections.

docs/durable.md:105 2. If the conversation has an unused answer with that key, the call returns it. An answer is an entry of kind `ui.answer` with data `{ key, kind, answer, by?, url? }`: `answer` is a boolean for confirm and a string for select and input. pi-action writes it as the user message that delivers the answer. An answer of the wrong type is skipped.

docs/durable.md:150 - **Treat prompts as code.** Whoever can write to the conversation, for example by commenting on an issue that pi-action answers, can ask the model to run commands. Limit who can drive the conversation, and keep secrets the job does not need out of the host's environment.
docs/README.md:15 | [pi-durable hosts](durable.md)        | Run Pit's tool on a pi-durable host such as pi-action, and know what differs from Pi              |
